desc:
Crash Car Physics is a vehicle crash game 🚗💥 where speed meets destruction! 🔥
Test your driving skills (or just cause pure chaos 😈) with realistic crash physics and insane damage effects!

🚗 Some vehicles are from @realgrivilio (with his permission ✅)

👍 Remember to Favorite and Like!
🚗 Join the group to get access to exclusive group cars!

🎮 Main Controls:
PC / Console

Driving: WASD
Lights: L / H
Handbrake: P
First Person: V / DPadLeft / Click pop up arrow on mobile
Wheelie: Left Ctrl / Pull Thumbstick Down
Nitro (only supported vehicles): Shift / Button B
View lap times (only tracks): Hold J

Formerly known as Car Crash Physics/WreckShift
